events.label: Sweep best of 6
events.summary: Sweep best of 6: 35.9 ± 2.7 vs 21.9 ± 3.0 for current practice (residents (of the sample) who visit libraries in a week). SW Sweep best of 6 wins because it raises weekly library visitors from 21.9 ± 3.0 under current practice to 35.9 ± 2.7, a gain of about 14.0 points. It also beats the next-best tested options in every held-out scenario (36.875 vs 31.625/29.0 in A, 39.875 vs 33.125/30.5 in B, and 37.0 vs 31.5/29.875 in C). Budget (budget of town-run places (Cant Hook Park, Evart Library-Museum, Evart Skate Park, Moose Family Center, Sports ground, Sports ground)): $810.0k/yr (+$41.0k vs current; wage $25/h from model default ($25/staff hour incl. benefits)).
events.assumptions: This result depends on the synthetic resident schedules and the model-default arrival and word-of-mouth rates; it also assumes the simulated capacity change to 10 is implemented as coded and that the library’s current online channel remains available.
events.pilot: Run a one-month pilot of the SW capacity-10 schedule at Evart Library-Museum and track weekly unique visitors, peak-hour crowding, and any turned-away arrivals, comparing against the prior month or matched weeks.
